landing.joinCodePlaceholder: Kenya khoutu ea linomoro tse tšeletseng
landing.heroSubtitle: Lithuto tse sebelisanwang tse nang le khopolo-taba, khoutu e hlalositsweng, le diteko tse potlakileng — tsohle ka nako ya sebele.
landing.feature1Desc: Dikahare tse ruileng tsa markdown ka diboloko tsa khoutu tse totobaditsweng le ditlhaloso tse sebelisanang.
landing.feature2Desc: Tobetsa moleng ofe kapa ofe o totobaditsweng ho fumana tlhaloso e qaqileng ya seo o o etsang.
landing.feature3Desc: Lipotso tsa teko tsa nako e lekanyelitsoeng tsa mofuta oa Kahoot, tse nang le tlhahlobo ea lintlha hang-hang le lethathamo la ba etelletseng pele.
landing.feature4Desc: Tšoara thupelo e phelang 'me u tataise baithuti mohato ka mohato — lisebelisoa kaofela li ntlafatsoa hang-hang.
landing.step1: Bopa papali ea hau ka mehato ea thuto le liteko tse khutšoane.
landing.step2: Qala kopano 'me u arolelane khoutu ea memo kapa u romele limemo tsa imeile.
landing.step3: Tataisa bankakarolo ka litaba ka nako ea sebele.
landing.ctaTitle: U itokiselitse ho qapa papali ea hau ea pele?
landing.metaTitle: Hakoot - Sethala sa Lipotso tse Kopanetsoeng
landing.metaDescription: Theha le ho bapala lipotso tsa khoutu tse sebelisanang le bamameli ba hao.
